required_checks.label: Character identity
required_checks.criteria: Faces, age presentation, hair, costume silhouette, and key props match the approved character references.

required_checks.label: Character props
required_checks.criteria: Tuobaye keeps the green bamboo flute; Shennong keeps white hair and deep purple robe unless the shot brief explicitly changes it.

required_checks.label: Location identity
required_checks.criteria: Nanjishan meadow, distant sea, waterfall mist, poplar/catkins, grass, and golden light remain recognizably consistent.

required_checks.label: Storyboard match
required_checks.criteria: Composition, shot size, action beat, and emotional intent match the approved storyboard frame.

required_checks.label: Motion continuity
required_checks.criteria: Camera movement and character motion remain stable, with no face morphing, costume swapping, scene teleporting, or sudden object changes.

required_checks.label: Safety constraints
required_checks.criteria: No minor-looking characters, dangerous cliff emphasis, falling, injury, gore, or unsafe action.

required_checks.label: Clean output
required_checks.criteria: No captions, calligraphy, watermarks, logos, UI panels, or design-sheet artifacts in video frames.

required_checks.label: Technical output
required_checks.criteria: MP4 exists, is playable, has expected duration class, and is saved under the shot's planned output path.
